correctness.rationale: The Yule generator closes eleven first/second moments. The resulting explicit solutions satisfy the initial conditions and differential equations; direct substitution gives both covariance identities. For the residual sign, \(g(r)=r^4-6r^2+24r\log r-4r+9\) has \(g(1)=0\) and strictly positive derivative for \(r>1\) by a second monotonicity argument. The raw numerator is likewise strictly positive after differentiating to a manifestly positive fourth derivative. The checker independently replays the ODE identities and finite sign grids but is not treated as proof of the continuum statement.

value.rationale: Cherry count and total pendant length are canonical Yule shape and branch-length observables. The exact sign reversal after subtracting their natural tip-count components isolates intrinsic dependence from random-population-size confounding, while the nonzero limiting residual correlation shows a persistent effect rather than a vanishing finite-sample artifact.
